scope: Generated toy inputs exercise code contracts only; no biological efficacy evidence
checks: Observed values/errors/masks never enter any feature matrix (SHAPE and DMS)
Rigid translation/rotation leaves local geometric invariants and predictions unchanged
Pairing negative control preserves all-row geometry marginals and exact coefficient count
Shuffle preserves geometry marginals on the scored DMS A/C subset (v1 all-row scheme detectably does not)
DMS observations at chemically ineligible G/U positions are rejected
Changing held-out targets and errors cannot change that fold's normalization, alpha or coefficients
Held-out feature distribution cannot contaminate training standardization
Replicate profile cannot increase its lineage's total training weight
Unweighted refit uses unit precision (uniform within profile) with identical features
Missing observations and unmapped coordinates use a common mask in all arms
Observed-null corruption and explicitly synthetic biological inputs are rejected
Unknown secondary annotations x/X/?/- stay masked rather than becoming pair labels
Exact, single-substitution and contained near-identical sequences cannot cross lineages; unrelated ones pass
Raw coordinate-source byte corruption is rejected against the provenance pin
Changed-code/frozen-plan mismatch aborts before any model output
Freeze requires a passed extraction audit of the exact cohort; audit change after freeze aborts the run
End-to-end toy freeze/run executes both weighting schemes and all frozen comparisons
